status: frozen before the primary GCP attempt
purpose: Run the complete systems workload on a controlled CPU-only GCP host after retaining all watgpu attempts as non-primary engineering history.
primary_source_rule: One complete attempt launched by run_scaling_faults_gcp.sh is the sole primary numeric source. Earlier watgpu attempts and GCP smoke attempts are excluded from primary analysis.

inference.thread_source: Explicit RAP_PAW_N_THREADS and RAP_PAW_N_THREADS_BATCH environment variables consumed by the supervised inference worker.

rehearsal_evidence.gcp-smoke-004: All five units terminal under the isolated experiment user; four matrix units completed.
rehearsal_evidence.gcp-smoke-005: All twelve units terminal; every fault type and exact online/offline replay executed; offline predictions exactly equaled online predictions.
rehearsal_evidence.gcp-smoke-006: All five units completed with explicit 8/8 llama.cpp thread settings and exit code 0.

interpretation.fault_probe_failures: Measured system outcomes, not infrastructure failures, when their unit terminal record is valid and cleanup isolation passes.
interpretation.attempt_eligibility: Requires every planned unit terminal, a valid result.json, unchanged scoped Git source, complete runtime artifacts, and primary_numeric_eligible=true.
interpretation.non_censoring: The first launched complete primary GCP attempt is retained and reported regardless of favorability.
